title: [3.1.0.3-dev-a] No pairing for Dana-i/RS after clicking Selected Pump
body:
After clicking Selected Pump in Dana-i/RS Preferences nothing happens, I'm unable to pair the pump.

- phone BT is on
- every permission for AAPS is given
- I've reset pairing information after long clicking BT status on the DANA Tab
- after short clicking BT status on the DANA Tab it tries to connect (counts the seconds)
- there were no Dana pumps paired with AAPS before (just a Combo)
- the Dana pump I'd like to pair, can communicate with the AnyDana app on the same phone

Workaround:
- reverting back to 3.0.0.1 (479bfc410)
- pairing appeared after clicking Selected Pump in Dana-i/RS Preferences
- updating AAPS to 3.1.0.3-dev-a
- pump remained paired, communication working as it should
- but still nothing happens after clicking Selected Pump in Dana-i/RS Preferences
